subject: english
question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "abdicated" in the sentence given below:

During the meeting, he confidently asserted his viewpoint, providing compelling arguments to support his position.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abdicated"** means to renounce or relinquish a throne, right, power, claim, responsibility, or the like, especially in a formal manner. (त्याग दिया)

 
 
• **Example: **The king **abdicated** the throne in favor of his son.
 
 
 
• **"Asserted" **refers to stating something confidently and forcefully; to declare or affirm with assurance. (दावा किया)
 
 
• **Example: **During the debate, she **asserted **her opinions firmly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'abdicated' **is **'asserted'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confidently **(आत्मविश्वास से): In a self-assured way that expresses confidence.

 
 
• **Example:** She **confidently **walked onto the stage to deliver her speech.
 
 
 
• **Support **(समर्थन): To bear all or part of the weight of; hold up.
 
 
• **Example: **He **supports** his family by working two jobs.
 
 
 
• **Compelling **(आकर्षक): Evoking interest, attention, or admiration in a powerfully irresistible way.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so **compelling** that I couldn't look away.
